meta.comment: Business-rule gate for silver.fact_order_items. Composite PK (order_id, order_item_id). Quarantine already drops rows with null PK / null product / unparseable price.

meta.rationale: composite PK duplication would double-count items in gold revenue/volume marts
Olist max items per order in dataset is ~20; >100 indicates parsing drift
negative price or absurd value breaks revenue math in gold
freight outliers are rare anomalies, not pipeline failures
null seller breaks the join to dim_seller in gold
occasional nulls accepted; mostly threshold flags systemic issue
